subject: gk
question: Which of the following articles mentions about the Appropriation Bills in the state legislature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 204**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 204** of the Indian Constitution deals with the Appropriation Bills in the State Legislature.
 
• An Appropriation Bill is introduced to provide for the appropriation out of the Consolidated Fund of the State for the services of a financial year.
 
• The Appropriation Bill is required to authorize the withdrawal of funds from the Consolidated Fund of the State to meet the expenditure during the financial year.
 
• Once the demands for grants have been voted by the legislative assembly, the Appropriation Bill is introduced in the legislative assembly for its passage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 216**: This article pertains to the constitution of High Courts in the states, specifying the number of judges in a High Court.
 
• **Article 209**: This article deals with the procedures for the introduction and passing of bills in the state legislature, other than money bills.
 
• **Article 213**: This article empowers the Governor of a state to promulgate ordinances during the recess of the state legislature.
 
• **Consolidated Fund of the State**: It is a fund where all revenues received by the state government, loans raised by the government, and all money received by the government in repayment of loans are credited.
 
• **Demand for Grants**: These are proposals for spending money by the government departments, which are put to vote in the legislative assembly.
